title: WindowsIsoDownloader configuration
description: Drives the browser workflow that locates and downloads the Windows ISO from Microsoft.

DownloadFolder.description: Folder where the ISO is written.

DownloadFilename.description: Plain file name (no path separators) of the produced ISO.

PreferredArchitecture.description: Image to prefer when the page offers more than one ISO.

Attempts.description: How many times the whole browser workflow is attempted.

RetryDelaySeconds.description: Base delay between attempts; grows exponentially (capped at 60s).

Headless.description: Run the browser without a visible window.

ExperimentalSentinel.description: Best-effort, experimental warm-up of Microsoft's anti-bot handshake.

Actions.description: Ordered list of browser actions used to reach the download link.

WaitBeforeAction.description: Delay (ms) applied before running the action.

Optional.description: When true, a failure is logged and the workflow continues.

Selector.description: CSS selector, used by SelectOption, Click, QuerySelector and WaitForSelector.
